capabilities: Open CSV and TSV files from the vault
Edit data in a searchable table
Save changes back to the same file
Preserve BOM and newline conventions on save
Block overwriting when the file changed externally
extras: Closed-source: the repository ships only the compiled release, license, and third-party notices. Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.14.5 or later (version 0.1.2). Limits: UTF-8 files up to 5 MiB, 50,000 cells, 200 columns. Unsaved drafts live only in memory and are lost if you quit or disable the plugin without saving.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open and edit CSV or TSV files as a table, so spreadsheet-style data stored in the vault cannot be edited in place.
summary: Table editor that opens local CSV and TSV files from the vault, lets you edit the searchable grid, and saves changes back to the same file.
